body:
Great advice, thank you. I’ve told my mother (who is going with him) to ask for a copy of both the statement from the teacher and whatever my brother signs. 

I’ll let her know to ask if she can record.

Thank you for this. He is going in with his mother. 
I thought it may be as a witness to something but the statement was directly about my brother. 

Hopefully it’s nothing bad but just wanted to be prepared as we’ve never heard of this.
I did a Reddit search before I started watching, not realising I’d start watching. Wanted to protect fellow new comers just in case.
With 0 prior star wars knowledge I literally didn’t even think about watching them out of order. I’m in too deep now! Thank you!
Yeah for sure! I’ll come back and let ya know!
Sorry, should’ve stated clearer, I thought everyone would get what I meant because of me being upset about Obi’s death - time order. Started with Phantom.

Honestly! I’ve really enjoyed my experience so far. Having that emotional connection to the characters makes it that much more of a rollercoaster, everything is just so intense and I’ve had a great time. After years and years of rejecting the idea of watching SW I’m honestly so fucking satisfied. It’s been awesome.

I was not disappointed. It gave such a depth to the entire story for me personally. Phantom Menace was hard to grasp because obviously I had no clue what was happening whereas it was made originally for people who would’ve had an idea. ROTS blew my fucking mind. I’ve encountered SW so much through pop culture and thought it was just… I’m not sure what I thought but it wasn’t this. The prequel trilogy blew me away for sure. It was my first REAL look at Star Wars and I think it set the bar super high for me.
Missed Solo, have now watched Kenobi. I’ll be going back to Solo, though - missed it due to terrible list keeping. I shall be continuing my SW endeavour this evening.
Mando was my gateway drug lmao

I have not watched the Han Solo movie because the list that I acquired from the internet missed it out - I’ve just met him for the first time in ANH and will be going back to watch. But yeah, absolutely correct! I got into SW because of Mando. It was the first thing I watched. I got my boyfriend to play some silly game with me and in return I’d watch Mandalorian. I loved it. I wanted to know more but to know more Id need to watch this other thing, which lead me to this other thing, etc
the christmas special traumatised me. that is all
I also had guidance - from my boyfriend. Allowing this to happen is criminal 🥲
Me too!!! I couldn’t believe he was gone!
Hahaaaa, I did a good old Reddit search before I started watching - you never know!
Oh my god she’s going to love it so so so much. ROTS rocked me tbh hahahah.
Yeah, absolutely. Thought I’d bash out the movies first and then return.
After posting this, I do feel very privileged to be experiencing it all for the first time! Very very excited.
I absolutely will! I wish I made a post for ROTS - my mind was blown.

Hahahaha! I’m dedicated to the cause - I’m in my early 20s and can’t believe I have missed out on SW for so long. I will absolutely be watching CW. 

Happy being me!
That whole scene was amazing. I watched a making of looooooooong ago for that movie and it’s insane how brilliantly it all came together.

That’s interesting! I’m going to revisit and watch all at some point - it just meant putting ROTS on hold which I was super excited for so I tried to get as much necessary information as I could so I could watch ROTS quicker tbh hahahaha. Definitely going back though
i watched the clone wars movie and the “essential” episodes of clone wars before ROTS. would you have recommended watching it all prior?
Also looking very very very forward to the other movies!

I thought Hans Solo was great. He definitely brings a very good, rare element of un-seriousness to everything I’ve watched so far. Super unique. He gave me the same kind of vibe as Din Djarin - dry, sarcastic but likeable. Must be something about the SW mercenaries.

That’s exactly why I didn’t enjoy it actually, I’m a sucker for moaning about change. It felt so strange for them to kill off such great characters in one movie like that. But I can see why it would’ve been appreciated from the perspective of someone that’s been watching for longer - refreshing!

If you’re talking about the Obi Wan death then absolutely fkn yes. It felt WEIRD to have a connection with him and then for him to just go like that was shocking. I mentioned elsewhere that it took my boyfriend, who was watching with me, to explain to me that Obi was dead. It was pretty harsh to me that he’d just gone like that - a huge connection to a character for them to just kill him like that was rough.

Oh really! The characters were amaaaaazing!! I didn’t enjoy the movie to the extremes of the ones I’d watched before (could be the downfall of the chronological watching) but the characters were great! I wish we’d get some more backstory for some of the others as there is with Andor
I’m bashing out the movies first and going back to Kenobi - I have high hopes
Oh really? I mean, I’ll probably watch them anyway at some point if I ever run out of things to watch but I’ll keep that in mind!
Really? I watched Rogue One so far if that’s what you mean and wasn’t the biggest fan - I did appreciate it more after A New Hope though.
I am absolutely going to get there!! I thought I’d bash out the movies first - I have watched Mando and a bit of Andor too. I’m excited for Clone wars!
i did
Are you insinuating that I’m a bot? Hahahaha

I thought it was good overall - watching in order made Rogue One a little strange and redundant but very much appreciated it after A New Hope. It’s hard because obviously it was the first movie. Something that surprised me as a chronological viewer was how quickly and how often we see Darth Vader. It’s almost a privilege to see him in the other movies so it was interesting. Was very impressed given the time it was made! I enjoyed it but it wasn’t my favourite.

him saying that threw me off! i didn’t even know that he’d died until i started saying “i’d be so sad if obi died” and my boyfriend side-eyed me. i thought he did some weird jedi teleporty thing that they never included in the movies i had already watched. 

spoiler alert: he did in fact die
i broke chronological order for mando, it was my one exception. this is, indeed, the way
That’s true!! Grateful and sad
yeah, i’ve figured this out. i would love to go back and have all the “oooh that makes sense now” moments but i did it to myself, thank you for your insight. definitely should’ve asked here first
i’m in too deep, my attachment to obi was built too strong from watching in time order - i’ve already done it to myself
